observed_local_validation.test_storage: Existing in-memory Bucket/Queue fixtures and stubbed source/fetch adapters only

behavior_review.conclusion: One product pagination operation requests global and market aliases, returns Translation.market identity and includes both only for a non-primary published locale. With no configured market, only the global alias is requested. Country/currency/publication identity logic is unchanged.

Each requested title/body_html/handle resolves a present market override before global fallback and before outdated filtering. A selected stale required field or handle fails, rather than silently using fresh global content. Stale lower-priority records may remain raw when a current override wins; that is field precedence, not a stale-content bypass.

Current title/body_html remain required; cleaned empty content fails the existing variant validation. Missing handle preserves the source handle, while explicit empty, stale or invalid selected handles fail. Any applicable product/variant error returns no rows/TSV; publication exclusions remain distinct and unchanged.

Raw alias arrays remain in snapshots; collector adds selected records and field provenance. Generator recomputes from raw scopes and rejects a provenance-marked object whose raw scopes are stripped. Checkpoint journals retain raw API responses and recompute derived provenance when replayed. Legacy snapshots remain compatible without a new provenance claim; these cannot establish global/market scope by themselves.

Primary-English and legacy-Spanish fixture feed bytes stay pinned. LandingContextVerified, freshness, complete-source checks, IDs, country/contextual pricing, exclusions and return logic are unchanged. No translation quality or exact live /es selection guarantee follows from passing these fixtures.

checkpoint_compatibility_probe.method: Existing before enqueue/consume produced a two-read checkpoint; the candidate consumer attempted its next revision using the existing fixture Bucket/Queue/source. No persisted harness or files created.
checkpoint_compatibility_probe.scope_limit: Demonstrates a journal containing the changed product operation. A journal containing only unchanged earlier operations is not covered by this failure claim; already completed/promoted jobs have existing separate handling.

required_before_owner_runs_new_collector: Validate the exact frozen PRODUCTS_QUERY and variables against Admin GraphQL 2026-07, including Product.translations locale/marketId types, Translation.market{id} and both Boolean include directives. node --check and string/fixture tests are not GraphQL schema validation.

Parent must bind a deliberate versioned successor and exact existing pipeline caller/import paths while preserving automation_release_v1 as evidence. This private file subset is a reviewed patch and test tree, not a deployment/activation manifest.

Existing Merchant owner must use the authorized account and exact current US/es/market/catalog/publication context to verify raw global market=null and exact market-ID response scopes, locale/outdated/value shapes, permissions, and actual query cost/throttle behavior. Keep both alias arrays and dated scope provenance. Do not reuse an old-operation in-flight journal; use the existing supported fresh-run lifecycle under its own authority.
required_before_any_activation_or_feed_r: Independently qualify a fresh complete source/candidate with all current holds and exclusions preserved. Do not force counts, drop stale products into a new partition or use legacy snapshots to claim newly verified scope.

Keep the reported stale-content cohort and exact current US/es direct-link/landing failures as separate unresolved gates; outdated=false alone does not prove correct Spanish or live storefront equivalence.

Only the parent can integrate or authorize a source/hosting/activation change after exact account identity, before-state, rollback and receiving validation are concrete. This review grants no upload, hosting, scheduler, source or paid authority.

next_action: Parent validates the exact versioned integration and query schema before handing the existing Merchant owner a bounded read-only fresh scope collection; keep source freshness and landing acceptance independent.
